title: دمج ريموشن مع انتي جرافيتي
description:
Clone and download the complete official Remotion repository into this empty workspace folder (including all packages, templates, and .agents/skills).
Then automatically open the terminal and execute the full setup end-to-end:
1. Install all required dependencies and toolchains (Bun / Node packages) and build the workspace packages.
2. Load the repository's AGENTS.md rules and Remotion skills, and prepare a clean 60fps vertical (9:16, 1080p & 4K) motion graphics workspace with 3D (@remotion/three) and Google Fonts ready.
3. Verify zero build errors and automatically launch Remotion Studio on localhost so everything is live and ready for production.
